\textbf{Solve the system.}
\begin{enumerate}[resume]
\item $\begin{array}{rrcr}
x & +y & = & -2\\
x & -y & = & 18
\end{array}$\vfill
\item $\begin{array}{rrrr}
x & +6y & = & -5\\
-4x & +7y & = & 20
\end{array}$\vfill
\end{enumerate}
\textbf{Write an augmented matrix for the following systems of equations.}
\begin{enumerate}[resume]
\item $\begin{array}{rrrr}
x & +y & = & -2\\
-2x & -y & = & 1
\end{array}$\xspace\xspace
\item $y=-x-2$ and $y=x-18$.\xspace\xspace\newpage
\end{enumerate}
\textbf{Solve the problem.}
\begin{enumerate}[resume]
\item In a losing effort against the Nets, Lebron James scored a total of
26 points on 3-point and 2-point shots. If he made a total of 12 shots,
how many 3-point and how many 2-point shots did he make?\vfill
\item There were 570 people at a school football game. The admission price
was \$2 for adults and \$1 for children. The admission receipts were
\$830. How many adults and how many children attended? \vfill
\end{enumerate}
